feature: Shift-click straight lines and Shift-drag axis constraint
where: All painting tools
inpig: StrokeTool and DabTool never read p.shift and keep no last-stroke end point.

where: Alt+right-drag (Win) / Ctrl+Option-drag (Mac): size, hardness or opacity with a red preview
inpig: No drag gesture for size/hardness.

feature: Pen tilt, barrel rotation and stylus wheel input
where: Brush Settings control menus; tablet input
inpig: canvas-view.js passes pressure, tiltX and tiltY to tools, but BrushStroke.local() keeps pressure only; twist and tangential pressure are never read.

where: Brush Settings: Apply Per Tip, Foreground/Background Jitter, Hue / Saturation / Brightness Jitter, Purity
inpig: Not implemented; the dab colour is fixed for the stroke.

where: Brush Settings: Opacity Jitter, Flow Jitter, Wetness Jitter, Mix Jitter and controls
inpig: Only the 'pressure -> opacity' toggle, which scales flow per dab.

where: Brush Settings: Scatter, Both Axes, Count, Count Jitter and controls
inpig: Not implemented.

where: Brush Settings: Tilt X, Tilt Y, Rotation, Pressure and overrides
inpig: Not implemented.

feature: Noise, Wet Edges, Build-up, Smoothing, Protect Texture
where: Brush Settings: checkbox options
inpig: None of the five exists in BrushStroke.

where: Brush Settings: pattern, Scale, Brightness, Contrast, Texture Each Tip, Mode, Depth, Minimum Depth, Depth Jitter
inpig: Not implemented (no pattern library to draw from either).

where: Brush Settings: second tip, Mode, Size, Spacing, Scatter, Count
inpig: Not implemented.

where: Brush Settings: size / angle / roundness jitter, minimum diameter, tilt scale, Flip X/Y jitter, Brush Projection, Control menus (Fade, Pen Pressure, Pen Tilt, Stylus Wheel, Rotation, Direction, Initial Direction)
inpig: Only the fixed 'pressure -> size' toggle (BrushStroke.effectiveSize). No jitter, no Fade or direction control.

where: Brush Tip Shape: Hardness, Distortion, Granularity, Spatter Size, Spatter Amount
inpig: Not implemented.

where: Brush Tip Shape: Softness, Shape, Sharpen Tip
inpig: Not implemented.

where: Brush Tip Shape: bristle shapes, Bristles, Length, Thickness, Stiffness, Angle; Live Tip Brush Preview
inpig: Not implemented.

feature: Sampled (image) brush tips and Define Brush Preset
where: Edit > Define Brush Preset; Brush Tip Shape tip list
inpig: dabCanvas() only builds round dabs; there is no bitmap tip and no Define Brush Preset command.

where: Options bar butterfly menu: Vertical, Horizontal, Dual Axis, Diagonal, Wavy, Circle, Spiral, Parallel Lines, Radial, Mandala; transformable symmetry path
inpig: No symmetry code (README lists the brush engine gaps but not this one).

where: Options bar: Enable airbrush-style build-up; Brush Settings: Build-up
inpig: No time-based dabs: a stationary pointer deposits one dab. The 'Airbrush' presets in panels/brushes.js are only low-flow round tips.

feature: Number keys set opacity; Shift+number sets flow
where: Painting tools: 1-0, Shift+1-0
inpig: keymap.js has no digit bindings.

where: Toolbar: Brush group; Wet, Load, Mix, Flow, presets (Dry ... Very Wet Heavy Mix), load / clean after each stroke, current load swatch, Sample All Layers
inpig: Not implemented (README: missing). Needs a per-dab reservoir/pickup model and ideally bristle tips.

feature: Retouch tools share the brush engine (presets, dynamics, spacing)
where: Blur, Sharpen, Smudge, Dodge, Burn, Sponge, Healing, Color Replacement, Background Eraser brush pickers
inpig: These are DabTool subclasses with their own round mask (R.dabMask), fixed spacing and only size and hardness; the Brushes panel notes 'This tool uses size and hardness only'. No angle, roundness, spacing or presets for them.

where: Brush / Pencil / stamp / fill options bar: Mode
inpig: All 26 layer modes (Canvas blend or per-pixel blendImages). Missing the painting-only modes Behind and Clear, and Dissolve is filtered out (BLEND_OPTIONS). Clone Stamp, Pattern Stamp, History Brush and Eraser have no Mode menu at all.

feature: Brush Tip Shape: size, angle, roundness, hardness, spacing, Flip X / Flip Y
where: Brush Settings panel: Brush Tip Shape
inpig: lib/panels/brushes.js sliders for size, hardness, spacing, angle, roundness (plus flow, opacity). Spacing is one global value (settings.brush.spacing), not per tool. No Flip X / Flip Y, no angle/roundness dial, no spacing on/off.

feature: Alt temporarily samples a colour while painting
where: Brush, Pencil, Color Replacement, Paint Bucket, Gradient, shapes + Alt
inpig: Brush and Pencil only (Alt-click calls eyedropper.sampleAt). Paint Bucket uses Alt for the background colour instead; other tools do nothing.

feature: Brush angle and roundness quick control
where: Options bar: brush angle; Brush preset picker angle/roundness widget
inpig: Angle and roundness are sliders in the Brushes panel only (tool options fed through installTipHook); no draggable ellipse widget, no arrow-key rotation.

feature: Brush tool: size, hardness, opacity, flow
where: Toolbar: Brush (B); options bar
inpig: Size stops at 1,000 px (lib/tools.js BRUSH_OPTIONS and lib/panels/brushes.js SIZE_MAX; the Pencil at 500 px) where Photoshop allows 5,000 px. Hardness, opacity and flow are complete.

feature: Painting in 16 and 32 bits per channel
where: All painting and retouch tools in 16/32-bit documents
inpig: Strokes are composited on the 8-bit canvas and lib/depth.js rebuilds the deep data of touched pixels from it (documented in README). Gradients and soft brushes band in 16-bit documents.

where: Brush engine
inpig: Dabs are cached Canvas radial-gradient sprites (size rounded up to whole pixels, smoothstep falloff, 8-bit) drawn with drawImage; angle/roundness by canvas transform. Photoshop computes each tip analytically at sub-pixel size. Differences show as slightly different soft-edge falloff and stepping in very small soft brushes.

feature: Pressure toggles: pressure for size, pressure for opacity
where: Options bar buttons
inpig: Checkboxes 'Pen pressure -> size' and 'Pressure -> opacity'. The opacity one scales per-dab flow (BrushStroke.dab), not stroke opacity, so overlapping dabs still build to full opacity. No override of the Brush Settings controls because those do not exist.

where: Options bar: Smoothing 0-100% and gear (Pulled String Mode, Stroke Catch-up, Catch-up on Stroke End, Adjust for Zoom)
inpig: One slider 0-0.95 driving an exponential moving average of the pointer (BrushStroke.extend); the stroke always jumps to the release point (a fixed catch-up on stroke end). None of the four modes; no leash line.

where: Brush Settings / Brushes panel preview
inpig: panels/brushes.js drawStroke paints an S curve with the current tip, spacing, flow and opacity.

feature: Painting on layer masks and in Quick Mask; selection clipping; lock transparency
where: Painting tools
inpig: StrokeTool.strokeTarget switches to the mask; BrushStroke 'mask' mode paints the grey value; the selection clips in flush(); locked transparency keeps alpha.

where: Painting tools
inpig: tool:brush-size-up/down and hardness (app.js adjustBrush; graded size steps, 25% hardness steps).

where: Toolbar: Brush group; options bar
inpig: PencilTool: aliased whole-pixel dabs, size, opacity, mode, Auto erase (starts in the background colour when the first pixel is the foreground colour).

feature: Patch tool: Content-Aware mode (Structure, Color, Sample All Layers)
where: Patch options bar: Patch: Content-Aware
inpig: Only the Normal heal is implemented.

feature: Spot Healing Brush: Create Texture, Mode, pressure toggle
where: Spot Healing options bar
inpig: No Create Texture type, no Mode menu (Replace, Multiply, Screen, Darken, Lighten, Color, Luminosity), no pressure-for-size button.

feature: Content-Aware Move tool (Move / Extend, Structure, Color, Transform On Drop)
where: Toolbar: Healing group
inpig: No tool; the inpainter in content-aware.js could back it.

where: Toolbar: History Brush group; Style (Tight Short ... Loose Curl), Area, Tolerance
inpig: Not implemented (README: missing).

where: Window > Clone Source: five sources, X/Y offset, W/H scale, rotate, flip, Show Overlay (opacity, Clipped, Auto Hide, Invert, blend)
inpig: No panel; one source point per tool instance, no scale/rotate/flip.

where: Toolbar: Blur group; Mode, Strength, Sample All Layers, Finger Painting
inpig: SmudgeTool: size, hardness, strength, Finger painting. Missing Mode and Sample All Layers.

where: Toolbar: Blur group; Mode, Strength, Sample All Layers, Protect Detail
inpig: SharpenTool: size, hardness, strength (R.sharpenDab). Missing Protect Detail, Mode and Sample All Layers.

where: Toolbar: Blur group; brush picker, Mode, Strength, Sample All Layers, pressure
inpig: BlurTool: size, hardness, strength (R.blurDab). Missing Mode (Darken, Lighten, Hue, Saturation, Color, Luminosity), Sample All Layers and brush presets; works on pixels only (refuses masks).

where: Toolbar: Brush group; Mode, Sampling (Continuous / Once / Background Swatch), Limits, Tolerance, Anti-alias
inpig: ColorReplaceTool: Mode (Color, Hue, Saturation, Luminosity), Sampling Continuous / Once, Tolerance. Missing Sampling: Background Swatch, Limits (Discontiguous / Contiguous / Find Edges), Anti-alias.

where: Toolbar: Clone Stamp (S); Mode, Opacity, Flow, Aligned, Sample (Current Layer / Current & Below / All Layers), ignore adjustment layers
inpig: CloneStampTool: Alt-click source, Aligned, Sample all layers (on/off), brush options. Missing Mode, 'Current & Below', ignore-adjustments toggle, sampling from another document, and the overlay preview inside the cursor (only a crosshair marks the source).

where: Toolbar: Clone Stamp group; pattern picker, Aligned, Impressionist
inpig: PatternStampTool paints the single current pattern (Edit > Define Pattern) with Aligned. No pattern picker, no Impressionist, no Mode.

where: Toolbar: Dodge group (O); Range, Exposure, airbrush, Protect Tones
inpig: DodgeTool / BurnTool: Range (shadows, midtones, highlights), Exposure, Alt swaps between them. Missing Protect Tones and the airbrush toggle.

where: Toolbar: Dodge group; Mode Saturate / Desaturate, Flow, airbrush, Vibrance
inpig: SpongeTool: mode and flow. Missing Vibrance (clipping protection) and the airbrush toggle.

where: Toolbar: Eraser (E); Mode Brush / Pencil / Block, Opacity, Flow, Smoothing, Erase to History
inpig: EraserTool: three modes, erases to transparency or to the background colour on a transparency-locked layer. 'Erase to original' uses the saved state only (same limit as the History Brush); Block is 16 document pixels rather than a fixed screen size.

where: Toolbar: Eraser group; Sampling, Limits, Tolerance, Protect Foreground Color
inpig: BackgroundEraserTool: Sampling Continuous / Once / Background swatch, Tolerance, Protect foreground colour. Missing Limits (Discontiguous / Contiguous / Find Edges): it always erases every matching pixel under the dab.

where: Toolbar: Healing group; options bar
inpig: PatchTool: lasso or existing selection, drag to patch, Source/Destination. Only a dashed box follows the drag (no live preview). Missing Transparent, Use Pattern, Diffusion and the selection combine buttons.

where: Toolbar: Healing group; options: Mode, Source (Sampled / Pattern), Aligned, Use Legacy, Sample, Diffusion
inpig: HealingBrushTool: Alt-click source, Aligned, Sample all layers (on/off), size, hardness. R.heal moves each pixel toward source texture plus the destination's local mean colour (low-frequency transfer), not Poisson blending: seams show on strong gradients. Missing Mode, Source: Pattern, Sample 'Current & Below', ignore-adjustment-layers, Diffusion, Clone Source panel offsets.

where: Toolbar: History Brush (Y); source chosen in the History panel
inpig: HistoryBrushTool paints from history.savedSnapshot() only (the image as opened or last saved) and refuses when the canvas size changed. The History panel has snapshots but no 'set source for the history brush' column, so no arbitrary state can be the source. No Mode menu.

where: Spot Healing options bar: Type
inpig: Per dab: 8 candidate patches on a ring are scored by border colour and variance, the best is healed in (R.heal). Coarser than Photoshop's; visible on patterned areas.

where: Toolbar: Healing group; Pupil Size, Darken Amount
inpig: RedEyeTool: click (60 px box) or drag a box; pixels whose red exceeds green/blue inside a centred circle are desaturated and darkened. No pupil detection, so a click must be centred and the fixed 60 px area misses large or small eyes.

where: Toolbar: Spot Healing (J); Type: Content-Aware
inpig: lib/tools/retouch.js SpotHealingTool collects the stroke as a mask and runs app.contentAwareFill (src/shared/pixels/inpaint.js) on release; Sample All Layers present. Result appears after the stroke, and quality depends on the local patch inpainter rather than Adobe's PatchMatch.

where: Toolbar: Eraser group; Tolerance, Anti-alias, Contiguous, Sample All Layers, Opacity
inpig: MagicEraserTool with all five options.

where: On-canvas corner widgets on rectangles, triangles and polygons; Properties: per-corner radii with link toggle
inpig: 0.4: corner widgets on rectangles, triangles and polygons with the shape and path selection tools, per-corner radii with a link in Properties; no corner widgets with the Move tool's transform controls

where: Options bar: Path alignment (align / distribute components, Align To), Path arrangement (Bring Shape To Front ...)
inpig: No commands to align, distribute or reorder subpaths.

feature: Pen tool modifiers: Ctrl for Direct Selection, Space to reposition an anchor while dragging
where: Pen tool + Ctrl/Cmd, + Space
inpig: PenTool handles Shift and Alt only; Ctrl does nothing and Space starts panning.

where: Toolbar: Pen group
inpig: Not implemented.

where: Toolbar: Pen group (technology preview)
inpig: Not implemented; could reuse the Magnetic Lasso edge map once it traces edges.

where: Toolbar: Shape group
inpig: 0.4: Triangle tool in the Shape group, live, with corner radius

where: Options bar: New Layer, Combine, Subtract Front, Intersect, Exclude Overlapping, Merge Shape Components
inpig: All six for shape layers (PATH_OP_OPTION, path:op, path:merge-components; lib/path-ops.js). The menu is shown only in Shape mode, so components of a work path or saved path cannot be given an operation from the options bar.

where: Pen and Path Selection options bar in Path mode
inpig: 0.4: Mask and Shape buttons on the Path Selection and Direct Selection tools; not on the Pen tool's Path mode

feature: Pen options: Rubber Band, Auto Add/Delete, path overlay colour and thickness
where: Pen options bar and gear menu
inpig: Auto add/delete checkbox present. The rubber-band preview segment is always on (no toggle). No path colour / thickness setting.

where: Shape gear menu: Unconstrained, Square/Circle, Fixed Size, Proportional, From Center; Space repositions while drawing
inpig: 0.4: Unconstrained, Square / Circle, Fixed Size, Proportional, From Center; Space repositions while drawing

feature: Shape fill: none, solid, gradient, pattern
where: Shape options bar: Fill popup; Properties
inpig: 0.4: Fill swatch with none, solid, gradient and pattern, also in Properties

feature: Shape stroke: caps, corners (joins), dashed lines and presets, gradient / pattern strokes
where: Stroke Options popup and More Options dialog
inpig: 0.4: Stroke Options with alignment, caps, joins, dashes and presets, gradient and pattern strokes; no "Align dashes to corners and path ends"

where: Toolbar: Path Selection (A); options: Select Active Layers / All Layers, fill, stroke, W/H, path ops, alignment, arrangement, Align Edges, Constrain Path Dragging
inpig: PathSelectionTool: click or Shift-click subpaths, drag to move, Alt-drag duplicates, arrows nudge, Delete removes; live shapes stay parametric when all subpaths move. Options bar has only Selection / Fill / Stroke buttons: no Select: Active Layers / All Layers, no W/H/X/Y, no fill/stroke fields, no marquee selection of several paths.

where: Toolbar: Path Selection group; Constrain Path Dragging
inpig: DirectSelectionTool: click or marquee anchors, Shift adds, drag anchors, handles (Alt breaks symmetry) and curve segments. No Constrain Path Dragging switch, no Select: All Layers.

feature: Freeform Pen tool and Magnetic option
where: Toolbar: Pen group; Curve Fit, Magnetic (Width, Contrast, Frequency, pen pressure)
inpig: FreeformPenTool with Curve fit (simplify and smooth on release, closes near the start). The Magnetic option is missing.

feature: Polygon tool: sides, star ratio, smooth corners
where: Toolbar: Shape group; Sides, gear: Star Ratio, Smooth Star Indents, corner radius
inpig: 0.4: sides, Star Ratio, Smooth Star Indents, corner radius

where: Toolbar: Shape group; Weight / stroke, gear: Arrowheads Start / End, Width, Length, Concavity
inpig: 0.4: weight and arrowheads (start, end, width, length, concavity) in the gear menu

feature: Pen and shape tool mode: Shape / Path / Pixels
where: Options bar tool mode menu
inpig: Pen: Shape, Path. Shape tools: Shape, Path, Pixels (with Anti-alias). Pixels mode has no Mode / Opacity fields.

where: Shape options bar
inpig: 'Align edges' checkbox rounds the box to whole pixels (ShapeTool.box).

where: Shape options bar: Stroke, width, Stroke Options: Align
inpig: STYLE_OPTIONS: stroke on/off, colour, width 0.5-288 px, Inside / Center / Outside; changing them restyles the selected shape layer.

where: Toolbar: Pen (P)
inpig: lib/tools/vector.js PenTool: click corners, drag smooth points, close on the first point, Shift 45 degrees, Alt breaks handles, Backspace removes the last anchor, undo steps back one anchor, Enter/Esc finish.

feature: Add Anchor Point, Delete Anchor Point, Convert Point tools
where: Toolbar: Pen group
inpig: AddAnchorTool, DeleteAnchorTool, ConvertPointTool (click to corner, drag out handles, drag a handle independently, Shift 45 degrees).

where: Toolbar: Shape (U)
inpig: ShapeTool 'rect' (plus the legacy Rounded Rectangle tool 'rrect' with a Radius field); Shift square, Alt from centre, click for a size dialog.

where: Toolbar: Shape group
inpig: ShapeTool 'ellipse'.

where: Brushes panel menu: Import Brushes, Export Selected Brushes
inpig: No .abr reader or writer (README: missing). Needs the sampled-tip engine first; presets could meanwhile be exported in Pigment's own JSON.

where: Edit > Presets: Preset Manager, Export / Import Presets, Migrate Presets
inpig: No preset manager; brush presets and swatches live in the settings file only.

feature: Swatch files: .aco / .ase import and export, legacy swatches
where: Swatches panel menu: Import Swatches, Export Selected Swatches, Export Swatches for Exchange, Legacy Swatches
inpig: No swatch file support (only .act colour tables in the Indexed Color dialog, src/shared/pixels/quantize.js).

where: Window > Gradients: groups, new gradient, import / export .grd, legacy gradients, drag onto layers
inpig: 0.4: Window › Gradients with groups, new gradient and dragging onto layers; Import / Export use .pigment-presets files, not .grd (0.5)

where: Window > Patterns: groups, import / export .pat, legacy patterns; pattern pickers in Fill, Pattern Stamp, Paint Bucket, Pattern Overlay, brush Texture
inpig: 0.4: Window › Patterns with groups, and the pattern picker in Fill, Pattern Stamp, Paint Bucket, Pattern Overlay and Bitmap; no .pat files (0.5); brush Texture waits for the brush engine

where: Window > Shapes: groups, import / export .csh, legacy shapes, drag onto canvas
inpig: No panel; shapes are the 8 constants in tools/vector.js.

where: Window > Styles: layer style presets, groups, import / export .asl, legacy styles
inpig: No style presets (only Copy / Paste / Clear Layer Style).

where: Window > Tool Presets; options bar preset picker; Current Tool Only; New / load / save .tpl
inpig: No tool presets. Options persist per tool in settings.tools, which is the only saved state.

where: Toolbar: Gradient group; Fill Foreground / Pattern, Mode, Opacity, Tolerance, Anti-alias, Contiguous, All Layers
inpig: 0.4: Foreground or Pattern (the picker), tiles anchored to the document origin, Mode, Opacity, Tolerance, Anti-alias, Contiguous, All Layers

feature: Custom Shape tool and shape picker
where: Toolbar: Shape group; Shape picker with groups; Edit > Define Custom Shape
inpig: A dropdown of 8 built-in shapes (CUSTOM_SHAPES: heart, arrow, star, check, speech bubble, plus, bolt, drop). No thumbnails, no groups, no Define Custom Shape, no user shapes.

feature: Brushes panel: presets, groups, search, preset options
where: Window > Brushes: folders, drag to reorder, search, size slider, recent brushes, New Brush with 'Include Tool Settings' and 'Include Color', view options
inpig: A flat grid of 16 built-in round presets plus user presets (save, rename, delete; stored in settings.brushPresets with size, hardness, spacing, angle, roundness, flow). No groups, reorder, search, recent row, or tool/colour capture.

feature: Adobe's bundled and downloadable brush libraries
where: Brushes panel: General / Dry Media / Wet Media / Special Effects, Legacy Brushes, Get More Brushes (Kyle T. Webster packs)
inpig: Adobe's brush sets are licensed content and the extra packs come from Adobe's servers. Substitute: Pigment's own presets and user-supplied .abr files once import exists.

where: Alt+Shift+right-click (Win) / Ctrl+Option+Cmd-click (Mac); Hue Strip or Hue Wheel, sizes in Preferences
inpig: No HUD picker.

where: Color Picker checkbox
inpig: Not present.

where: Color Picker in 32-bit documents: Intensity, stops
inpig: The same 8-bit picker is used at every depth.

feature: Color Picker: sample from the image or anywhere on screen while open
where: Color Picker open + click in the document / drag outside
inpig: The dialog is modal over the canvas and has no sampling; the browser EyeDropper API is not used.

feature: Color Picker: out-of-gamut and not-web-safe warnings
where: Color Picker warning triangle and cube (click to snap)
inpig: Not present in the dialog (View > Gamut Warning exists for the canvas only).

feature: Eyedropper: sample anywhere on screen; Copy Color as Hex / HTML
where: Drag the Eyedropper out of the window; right-click menu
inpig: Sampling stops at the canvas; no use of the EyeDropper API or desktop capture; no copy-colour commands.

feature: Color Picker dialog: field, hue strip, HSB / RGB / Lab / CMYK / hex fields, new / current
where: Click the foreground or background swatch
inpig: lib/extras.js pickColor with createColorWidget: SB square, hue strip, HSB, RGB, hex, Lab and CMYK fields, new/current swatches, recent colours and swatches row. No radio buttons to change the field's axis (S, B, R, G, B, L, a, b). CMYK is a profile-less formula (differs from Photoshop's SWOP numbers).

where: Eyedropper options bar: Current Layer, Current & Below, All Layers, All Layers no Adjustments, Current & Below no Adjustments
inpig: Only 'All layers' and 'Current layer'.

where: Eyedropper options bar: Point, 3x3, 5x5, 11x11, 31x31, 51x51, 101x101
inpig: lib/tools/nav.js EyedropperTool: Point, 3x3, 5x5, 11x11, 31x31. 51x51 and 101x101 missing.

where: Color Picker > Color Libraries (PANTONE, TOYO, HKS, DIC, ANPA, FOCOLTONE, TRUMATCH)
inpig: Absent. The books are licensed data (Adobe itself dropped most Pantone books). Substitute: let the user load their own .acb / .ase / .aco libraries and ship only freely licensed sets.

where: Color Picker button
inpig: 'Add to Swatches' button appends to settings.swatches and refreshes the panel.

feature: Eyedropper: sampling ring, Alt-click for background, drag to sample
where: Eyedropper tool
inpig: Ring with new/previous colour (showRing option), Alt sets background, status bar shows hex and RGB.

where: Toolbar colour controls
inpig: ToolManager.renderToolbox swatches; tool:swap-colors, tool:default-colors, tool:pick-fg/bg.

feature: Move the selection outline (drag inside with a selection tool, arrow keys nudge)
where: Any selection tool: drag inside selection; arrow keys 1 px / Shift 10 px
inpig: Pointer down inside a selection starts a new marquee; selection tools have no onKeyDown for arrows. Only Select > Transform Selection moves the outline.

where: Magic Wand options bar: Sample Size (Point, 3x3 ... 101x101)
inpig: The wand always samples the single clicked pixel; it does not read the Eyedropper's sample size either.

feature: Marquee: Space repositions the marquee while dragging
where: Marquee / shape tools + Space during drag
inpig: Space always switches to the temporary hand (shortcuts.js sets view.spaceHeld); a drag in progress is not moved.

feature: Selection tools: Select and Mask / Select Subject buttons in the options bar
where: Options bar of marquee, lasso, wand, quick and object selection
inpig: The commands exist (select:select-mask, select:subject) but none of the selection tools' option lists has the buttons.

feature: Marquee Style: Normal / Fixed Ratio / Fixed Size
where: Marquee options bar: Style, Width, Height, swap button
inpig: All three styles with W/H fields. No swap W/H button, and Fixed Size takes pixels only (no in/cm/% units).

feature: Quick Mask button and Quick Mask Options
where: Toolbar: Edit in Quick Mask Mode (Q); double-click for Masked / Selected Areas, colour, opacity
inpig: Button and Q toggle select:quick-mask (edit-ops.js): a hidden grey layer with a fixed 50% red overlay on the unselected area. No options dialog (colour, opacity, selected-areas mode); the mask is not undoable.

where: Toolbar: Lasso (L)
inpig: LassoTool 'free': freehand outline closed on release. Holding Alt to switch to straight segments mid-drag is missing.

where: Toolbar: Lasso group
inpig: Click points, close on first point or double-click, Backspace removes the last point, Enter commits, Esc cancels. Missing: Shift constrains to 45 degrees, Alt-drag for freehand segments.

feature: Magnetic Lasso tool (Width, Contrast, Frequency, pen pressure)
where: Toolbar: Lasso group; options bar
inpig: LassoTool 'magnetic': each point (dropped every few pixels by Frequency) snaps to the strongest gradient inside the Width radius above the Contrast threshold; points are joined by straight lines. Photoshop traces the edge between fastening points (live-wire). A user sees a rougher outline on curved edges. No pen-pressure width toggle, no [ ] width keys.

feature: Object Selection tool: Rectangle / Lasso mode, Sample All Layers, Object Subtract, Hard Edge
where: Toolbar: Object Selection (W); options bar
inpig: lib/tools/object-select.js: region goes to a GrabCut in the segmentation worker (src/shared/pixels/segment.js). All four options present. Photoshop uses a trained model; on busy backgrounds Pigment's cut is visibly less reliable.

where: Toolbar: Quick Selection (W); options bar: brush picker, Sample All Layers, Enhance Edge
inpig: WandTool 'quick': tolerance flood fill from five seeds inside a window of three brush radii, plus the disc under the brush; Alt subtracts. Not Photoshop's edge-aware region growing, so it leaks or stops by tolerance rather than at object edges. Size only (no hardness/spacing/angle picker), no Enhance Edge; shows Tolerance and Contiguous options Photoshop does not have.

where: Marquee / Lasso options bar
inpig: feather 0-250 px and anti-alias on marquee and lasso tools (Selection.feather, fromEllipse/fromPolygon antialias).

feature: Selection tools: New / Add / Subtract / Intersect
where: Options bar buttons; Shift, Alt, Shift+Alt
inpig: COMBINE_OPTION segment plus combineMode() modifiers on marquee, lasso, wand, quick selection and object selection.

feature: Magic Wand: Tolerance, Anti-alias, Contiguous, Sample All Layers
where: Toolbar: Magic Wand (W); options bar
inpig: WandTool 'wand' through selectionOps.floodFill.

feature: Single Row and Single Column Marquee
where: Toolbar: Marquee group
inpig: MarqueeTool shape 'row' / 'column': 1 px row or column at the click.

where: Toolbar: Marquee tools (M)
inpig: lib/tools/select.js MarqueeTool: Shift = square/circle, Alt = from centre, modifier latching when a selection exists, size readout.

feature: Move tool: drag, reposition and delete existing guides
where: Move tool over a guide; Alt-click toggles orientation
inpig: 0.4: select, drag and delete guides (drag out of the canvas, or Delete); Alt-click to toggle a guide's orientation is not there

where: Toolbar: Eyedropper group (count groups, colour, marker and label size)
inpig: No count tool.

where: View > Show > Smart Guides; Ctrl/Cmd-hover distances, equal-spacing hints, Alt-drag distance
inpig: 0.4: alignment lines, equal-spacing hints and Ctrl-hover distances with the Move tool; not while drawing paths, and no angle readouts

where: Rotate View tool (R): drag, Shift for 15 degrees, Rotation Angle field, Reset View, Rotate All Windows
inpig: lib/tools/nav.js RotateViewTool: drag, Shift snaps to 15 degrees, Angle field and Reset view. No compass overlay while dragging and no Rotate All Windows (there is one view per document). R is shared with the Hand slot as the panels auditor notes.

where: Toolbar: Eyedropper group; options bar X, Y, W, H, A, L1, L2; Info panel
inpig: RulerTool shows length, angle, dX, dY only in the status bar while dragging. No options-bar fields, nothing in the Info panel, line endpoints cannot be dragged afterwards, no Shift 45 degree constraint, no protractor (Alt-drag a second line), no Use Measurement Scale.

where: Toolbar: Hand (H); Scroll All Windows, 100%, Fit Screen, Fill Screen; Space; flick panning; hold H for bird's-eye view
inpig: lib/tools/nav.js HandTool: drag to pan, Space from any tool, middle-button pan, double-click fits, three buttons. No Scroll All Windows, no flick panning, no bird's-eye view.

where: Toolbar: Zoom (Z); Zoom In/Out, Resize Windows to Fit, Zoom All Windows, Scrubby Zoom, 100%, Fit Screen, Fill Screen; Ctrl+Space / Alt+Space
inpig: ZoomTool: click, Alt-click, Scrubby zoom, marquee zoom when scrubby is off, Fit and 100% buttons. Missing Resize Windows to Fit and Zoom All Windows (one tabbed window), the Fill Screen button, Ctrl+Space / Alt+Space temporary zoom, animated press-and-hold zoom.

feature: Snapping (guides, grid, layers, document bounds, artboards, slices)
where: View > Snap, View > Snap To; all drawing tools
inpig: 0.4: guides, grid, layers and document bounds for every placing tool, nearest target first; artboards and slices wait for those features

feature: Ruler tool: Straighten Layer and Clear
where: Ruler options bar
inpig: Buttons run image:rotate with layerOnly and clear the line.

feature: Canvas right-click context menus for tools
where: Right-click on canvas with Move (layers under cursor), selection tools (Deselect, Feather, Layer Via Copy, Fill, Stroke, Make Work Path...), painting tools (brush picker), type, pen, shape
inpig: canvas-view.js forwards button 2 to tool.onContextMenu but no tool implements it; the browser menu is just suppressed.

where: Right-click the tool icon in the options bar
inpig: Only Preferences > Reset All Settings, which also resets preferences, swatches and layout.

where: Toolbar '...' > Edit Toolbar; Extra Tools; save / load toolbar presets
inpig: Slot order is hard-coded (SLOT_ORDER in lib/tools.js); no customisation, no two-column layout.

where: Window > Contextual Task Bar: floating bar with next actions per tool and selection
inpig: No floating task bar. Toolbar.setSecondary() can show a contextual strip but nothing uses it for this.

where: Ctrl/Cmd = Move tool from most tools; Alt = eyedropper in painting tools; Ctrl+Space zoom
inpig: 0.4: Ctrl = Move, Alt = Eyedropper with painting tools, Ctrl+Space and Alt+Space zoom; tools that use Alt keep it

where: Long-press / right-click a tool; letter keys; Shift+letter cycles; 'Use Shift Key for Tool Switch' preference; spring-loaded keys
inpig: 0.4: long-press or right-click flyouts, Shift+letter cycling, the 'Use Shift key for tool switch' preference, spring-loaded keys

where: Toolbar: Change Screen Mode (F): Standard, Full Screen With Menu Bar, Full Screen
inpig: No toolbar button and no F cycling. view:fullscreen (F11) is OS full screen and Tab hides the panels.

where: Toolbar: Frame tool (K): rectangle / ellipse frames, place image into frame
inpig: No frame layer type or tool.

where: Move tool + arrow keys (Shift = 10 px, Alt+arrow duplicates)
inpig: 1 px and Shift 10 px nudges (MoveTool.onKeyDown, one history entry each). Alt+arrow duplicate-and-nudge is missing; nudging selected pixels moves the whole layer instead of the selection content.

where: Move tool options bar
inpig: MoveTool.drawOverlay draws the bounding box and 8 handles, but they are not draggable (no hit testing); only double-click opens Free Transform.

where: Move tool options bar: Align left/centre/right/top/middle/bottom
inpig: Six align buttons run layer:align (layer-ops.js align(): to selection, to the union of selected layers, or to the canvas for one layer). No explicit 'Align To: Selection / Canvas' menu.

where: Move tool options bar: Auto-Select + Layer/Group menu
inpig: Checkbox 'Auto-select layer' and Ctrl/Cmd-click hit test (MoveTool.hitTest). No Group choice: always picks the leaf layer; marquee-drag on empty canvas to select several layers is missing.

feature: Move tool: distribute buttons and distribute spacing
where: Move tool options bar: Distribute (6 edges/centres) + Distribute Spacing (H/V), '...' flyout
inpig: No distribute controls in the options bar. Layer > Distribute has only Horizontally / Vertically (layer:distribute); no per-edge variants and no distribute spacing.

where: Move tool + Alt
inpig: MoveTool.duplicateLayers on p.alt; with a selection Alt duplicates the selected pixels (liftSelection keepOriginal).

feature: Move tool: move selected pixels (floating selection)
where: Move tool with an active selection
inpig: MoveTool.liftSelection cuts the pixels to a floating layer and commitFloating merges them back; the selection follows.

feature: Move tool: drag layers, Shift constrains, moves multi-selection and linked layers
where: Toolbar: Move tool (V)
inpig: lib/tools/move.js MoveTool; linked layers move together via app.linkedLayers; locked layers refused with a toast.

feature: Crop: Content-Aware fill of new canvas area
where: Crop options bar: Fill (Background / Content-Aware Fill / Generative Expand)
inpig: No fill choice on the crop tool. The parts exist separately (content-aware.js contentAwareFill, AI > Generative Expand with the user's key) but are not wired into the crop commit.

feature: Crop: Straighten and rotating the crop box
where: Crop options bar: Straighten; drag outside the box to rotate
inpig: CropTool has no angle: no Straighten line and no rotation by dragging outside the box (the Ruler tool's Straighten Layer is the only route).

where: Crop options bar gear: Use Classic Mode, Show Cropped Area, Auto Center Preview, Enable Crop Shield (colour, opacity, auto adjust)
inpig: Fixed 50% black shield drawn in CropTool.drawOverlay; none of the settings; the image never recentres under the box (always classic behaviour).

where: Crop options bar: overlay menu (Rule of Thirds, Grid, Diagonal, Triangle, Golden Ratio, Golden Spiral; Auto / Always / Never show; O cycles)
inpig: Rule of thirds, Grid, Golden ratio, None. Missing Diagonal, Triangle, Golden Spiral, the show modes and the O / Shift+O keys.

feature: Crop: ratio presets and size presets
where: Crop options bar: preset menu (Ratio, W x H x Resolution, Original Ratio, 1:1, 4:5, 5:7, 2:3, 16:9, New Crop Preset), swap, Clear
inpig: Free, 1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, Original ratio, Custom W:H. Missing: W x H x Resolution (resample on crop), 4:5 / 5:7 / 2:3, swap W/H button, Clear, saved crop presets.

where: Crop options bar
inpig: Checkbox 'Delete cropped pixels' passed to app.cropDocument.

feature: Crop tool: box, handles, move, Enter / double-click commit, Esc cancel, Reset
where: Toolbar: Crop (C)
inpig: lib/tools/move.js CropTool; size badge; commits through app.cropDocument.

where: Toolbar: Crop group; options bar W, H, Resolution, Front Image, Clear, Show Grid
inpig: lib/tools/perspective-crop.js with all those options; rasterizes text and smart layers (documented).

feature: Gradient Editor (colour stops, opacity stops, midpoints, smoothness, New / Save / Import / Export)
where: Click the gradient preview: Gradient Editor dialog
inpig: 0.4: colour and opacity stops, midpoints, smoothness, New, Save, Import, Export (.pigment-presets files; .grd in 0.5)

where: Gradient Editor: Gradient Type Noise (roughness, colour model, restrict colours, add transparency, randomize)
inpig: 0.4: roughness, colour model, restrict colours, add transparency, randomize

where: Gradient options bar / editor: Perceptual, Linear, Classic, Smooth, Stripes
inpig: 0.4: Perceptual, Linear, Classic, Smooth and Stripes for every gradient; PSD keeps it on Gradient Maps (Stripes as Classic)

where: Gradient options bar: Gradient vs Classic gradient; on-canvas line with draggable colour stops and midpoints, creates an editable Gradient Fill layer
inpig: 0.4: the Gradient tool's Gradient mode makes an editable Gradient Fill layer with an on-canvas line; the widget edits colour stops and end points, not midpoints or opacity stops

where: Gradient options bar: preset picker with thumbnails and groups
inpig: 0.4: picker with thumbnails and groups, presets kept across sessions

feature: Gradient tool: Mode, Opacity, Reverse, Dither, Transparency
where: Gradient options bar
inpig: All five options; dither is a 2x2 ordered +/-1.5 level pattern.

feature: Gradient tool: Linear, Radial, Angle, Reflected, Diamond
where: Toolbar: Gradient (G); options bar
inpig: lib/tools/fill.js GradientTool with document.js makeGradient (diamond rendered per pixel); Shift constrains to 45 degrees; works on masks.

feature: Color panel: other views and sliders
where: Color panel menu: Brightness Cube, Color Wheel, Grayscale / RGB / HSB / CMYK / Lab / Web Color Sliders; spectrum ramp (RGB, CMYK, Grayscale, Current Colors); Copy Color as HTML / Hex; gamut warning
inpig: Only the Hue Cube view; numeric fields but no sliders; no panel menu, no ramp, no copy-colour commands, no gamut alert.

where: Toolbar: Eyedropper group; Window > Notes
inpig: No note annotations.

where: Toolbar: Eyedropper group; Info panel readouts; up to 10 samplers
inpig: ColorSamplerTool: up to 8 samplers (Photoshop: 10), drag to move, Alt-click to delete, Clear; values in the Info panel. No sample-size option, no per-sampler colour-mode menu; doc.samplers is not in the undo history.

feature: Swatches panel: use, add, rename, delete, recent colours
where: Window > Swatches
inpig: lib/panels/swatches.js: click = foreground, Alt/Ctrl-click = background, add from foreground, rename, delete, reset to 60 defaults, recent row. No groups, drag reorder, search, list view or thumbnail sizes; swatches hold RGB hex only (no Lab/CMYK/spot).

feature: Color panel: Hue Cube with fields
where: Window > Color
inpig: lib/panels/color.js: SB square, hue strip, HSB / RGB / hex fields, foreground / background chips (double-click opens the picker), swap and default.

feature: Horizontal and Vertical Type Mask tools
where: Toolbar: Type group
inpig: Only the two type tools are registered.

where: Orientation toggle, font, style, size, anti-aliasing, alignment, colour, Warp Text, panels toggle, cancel / commit
inpig: Family, style, size, three alignments, colour, Character panel button. Missing the orientation toggle, anti-aliasing method and Warp Text.

where: Toolbar: Type (T)
inpig: lib/tools/text.js TypeTool x2: point text, paragraph box by dragging, click to edit, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter commits, text on a path entry.

where: Toolbar: Eyedropper and Gradient groups (legacy 3D)
inpig: No 3D in Pigment. Adobe has itself retired Photoshop's 3D features, so these belong with a 3D subsystem decision rather than the tools work.

where: Toolbar: Brush group (current release): paint an adjustment through a new masked adjustment layer
inpig: 0.4: in the Brush group; the first stroke adds a masked adjustment layer, later strokes paint its mask

where: Toolbar: Move group > Artboard tool (size presets, add-artboard plus buttons, orientation)
inpig: No artboard layer type or tool (README lists artboards as missing).

where: Preferences > Cursors: Standard / Precise / Normal Brush Tip / Full Size Brush Tip, crosshair in tip, precise while painting; Caps Lock toggles
inpig: Preference cursorStyle: outline, precise, dot. The outline is always a circle of the nominal size (ignores angle, roundness, hardness and pressure); no Caps Lock toggle, no crosshair-in-tip.

feature: Slice tool and Slice Select tool
where: Toolbar: Crop group
inpig: No slices anywhere (README: missing; Save for Web has no slices).

feature: Object Finder (hover preview, Show All Objects, overlay colour/opacity, refresh)
where: Object Selection options bar: Object Finder, gear menu
inpig: Absent. Adobe's object detector is a proprietary model. Honest substitute: an open-source segmentation model (e.g. Segment Anything in ONNX) that the user downloads, run locally in a worker to pre-compute object masks for hover; until then the tool needs a drag.

where: Toolbar: Healing group; Remove after each stroke, Sample All Layers, Find distractions (wires, people)
inpig: Absent. It runs Adobe's trained inpainting model (and Firefly for the generative mode). Closest honest substitutes: the same brush-then-fill gesture on Pigment's Content-Aware Fill (already what Spot Healing does), an open-source inpainting model (e.g. LaMa in ONNX) the user downloads, or Generative Fill through the user's OpenAI/Gemini key.
